label: Northgate University
summary: A hillside campus of lecture halls, rival clubs and a library open until 2 a.m., two weeks before midterms.

world.setting: Northgate University, a hillside campus in a small college town
world.description: Ivy-covered lecture halls, a library open until 2 a.m., rival student clubs, and a campus café where half of all confessions happen. Midterms are in two weeks.
rules: Grades, clubs and friendships all matter, and time runs out
Every student here is an adult with plans of their own

narration.tone: Bright, funny and a little dramatic
